description: Enforce minimum password complexity requirements via pam_pwquality (Linux) or Group Policy (Windows), ensuring user-chosen passwords resist brute force and dictionary attacks. Key enforcement parameters: minimum length (minlen, typically 14+), minimum character classes (minclass, requiring uppercase, lowercase, digits, and symbols), and dictionary checking (rejecting common words and variations). The combined effect is a search space of ~95^14 (~4.9x10^27) for online attacks, making brute force impractical within lockout windows. On RHEL/Fedora, pam_pwquality is the standard PAM module; on Debian/Ubuntu, it is available as libpam-pwquality. Windows enforces equivalent policy via Group Policy (Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Account Policies > Password Policy) or Fine-Grained Password Policies in Active Directory.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Without quality enforcement, users choose weak passwords (common words, short strings, credential-stuffing targets) that can be guessed via dictionary attack or brute force with minimal effort. With minlen=14 and minclass=4 enforced, the password search space grows to ~95^14 combinations, making online brute force impractical and offline cracking require significant resources even with GPU acceleration — the attacker must find an alternative authentication bypass rather than simply guessing the password

verification.method: Verify password quality enforcement via pwquality.conf (Linux) or Group Policy (Windows)

remediation.name: pam_pwquality configuration with minlen=14 and minclass=4

steps.description: Set minimum password length to 14 characters and require all 4 character classes (uppercase, lowercase, digit, special) in pwquality.conf
Ensure pam_pwquality.so is enabled in PAM system-auth (RHEL) or common-password (Debian) with retry=3 and enforce_for_root
steps.command: grep -q 'pam_pwquality.so' /etc/pam.d/system-auth 2>/dev/null || grep -q 'pam_pwquality.so' /etc/pam.d/common-password 2>/dev/null || echo 'password requisite pam_pwquality.so retry=3 enforce_for_root' >> /etc/pam.d/system-auth

remediation.name: Windows local password policy via net accounts

steps.description: Set minimum password length to 14 characters
Enable password complexity requirements (uppercase, lowercase, digit, special)
steps.command: secedit /export /cfg C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg && (Get-Content C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg) -replace 'PasswordComplexity\s*=\s*0','PasswordComplexity = 1' | Set-Content C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg && secedit /configure /db C:\Windows\Security\local.sdb /cfg C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg /areas SECURITYPOLICY
steps.undo: secedit /export /cfg C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg && (Get-Content C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg) -replace 'PasswordComplexity\s*=\s*1','PasswordComplexity = 0' | Set-Content C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg && secedit /configure /db C:\Windows\Security\local.sdb /cfg C:\Windows\Temp\secpol.cfg /areas SECURITYPOLICY
